name: elagi-api-testing
description: API test automation for the Elagi (علاجي) online healthcare and pharmacy web app — Postman + Newman

scripts.test:main: newman run collection/Elagi-API-Testing.postman_collection.json -e environment/Elagi.postman_environment.json --folder "Main Flow" -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/main-flow-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Elagi API - Main Flow" --reporter-junit-export reports/main-flow-junit.xml
scripts.test:all: newman run collection/Elagi-API-Testing.postman_collection.json -e environment/Elagi.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/full-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Elagi API - Full Regression" --reporter-junit-export reports/full-junit.xml

author: Asmaa Ebrahim
